stories.headline: B-Front & Phuture Noize Unveil New Live Act White Noise
stories.summary: B-Front and Phuture Noize will premiere their new live act 'White Noise' on March 13, 2027 at Poppodium 013 in Tilburg. The show follows their collab 'The Enlightenment' and blends hardstyle with melodic techno, trance and schranz.

stories.headline: WiSH Festival Skips 2027 Amid Rising Costs
stories.summary: Dutch hard dance festival WiSH has announced it will not hold an edition in 2027, citing soaring costs, complex productions, and growing risks. The organization leaves the door open for a future return but has given no timeline.

stories.headline: APEX 2027 Drops Massive B2B Lineup for March Mannheim Return
stories.summary: Germany's biggest indoor hardstyle event returns to Maimarkthalle Mannheim on 6 March 2027 for its fifth edition. Highlights include Ran-D B2B Vertile, A.N.I. B2B Rooler, and a special 20-year Noisecontrollers set.

stories.headline: Gunz For Hire's 15-Year Anniversary Was Pure Rawstyle Magic
stories.summary: REBiRTH Events celebrated 15 years of Gunz For Hire at The Dome in Haaren last Saturday with four exclusive showcases and a stacked lineup. Highlights included a B2B closing set with Angerfist and a brand-new anniversary track, 'Forever Gunz'.

stories.headline: Wolv & Level One Unite as The Ascension
stories.summary: Hardstyle artists Wolv and Level One have announced a new joint live act called The Ascension, blending their signature sounds with brand-new music. A debut date and venue are yet to be revealed.

caption: B-Front x Phuture Noize, APEX 2027, Gunz For Hire's legacy & more — here's everything that shook hard dance this week 🔥
